samples.question: Start with the ordered pair in START. The color cycle is amber → cyan → violet → amber. Read the seven COMMAND cards left to right. Each card has a color and a + or − sign. If its color matches the left register, move the right register one step in the signed direction; otherwise move the left register one step in the opposite direction. Carry both registers forward. Which two-letter code is active after command 7? Answer with the code from the key.
